info.title: Tasker Public API
info.description: Public REST API for the Tasker platform. All endpoints live under `/api/v1` and return Problem Details (RFC 7807) on error. Sensitive POSTs accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. See `/api/v1/docs` for the Swagger UI.
